subject: Contract stitching & onboarding timeline — sequencing dependencies and close plan
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
To: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.com>, Tom Ellison <tom@ellisonlegal.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Hi Prijom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to pull together a short plan that shows: (1) what needs to be signed (MSA, DPA, order form), (2) which internal approvals each requires, and (3) target dates so we can slot this into our July board procurement window.

Can you share a suggested sequencing (MAP-style) and call out any hard dependencies — e.g., whether we can run evals in parallel with DPA review, whether order form needs to wait for MSA redlines, or whether DocuSign can run in parallel with our procurement PO? Also curious about the estimated time for Redwood legal to review minor DPA comments.

Appreciate a one-pager or spreadsheet we can attach to our legal/procurement packet.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Dir. Strategic Sourcing
NovaMed Health

---

From: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Alicia —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a concise sequencing workbook (redwood-close-stitch-v1.xlsx) that lays out:
- Phase 0: Evaluation plan (pilot access, test datasets) — can start immediately once IP/NDA language is agreed; no need to wait for signed MSA but recommend an informal NDA for dataset sharing.
- Phase 1: MSA review and order form prep — MSA must be agreed before final order form signature if you want legal alignment on liability/indemnity. Order form content (SKUs/pricing) can be drafted in parallel.
- Phase 2: DPA comments and security evidence — DPA review often runs concurrently with MSA but DPA sign-off is required before production data access.
- Parallelization notes: We routinely run evals and sandbox work while legal reviews proceed. If you need production keys or PII handling, DPA completion is gating.

I flagged the hard dependency: production data access (and therefore final go-live) = DPA signed + order form executed. We can provision a seeded sandbox earlier.

Suggested timeline (based on similar customers):
- Week 0–1: NDA / initial evidence exchange
- Week 1–2: MSA first pass by both counsels
- Week 2–3: Order form pricing finalization (commercial) + DPA first pass
- Week 3–4: Legal redlines resolved, docs into DocuSign
- Target close: end of Week 4 (can be accelerated to Week 3 with focused scoping)

I attached the workbook and a one-page timeline PDF for your packet.

Next steps proposed:
1) You and procurement confirm whether they want the order form to be signed simultaneously with MSA or after legal sign-off.
2) We’ll assign our legal reviewer (cc’d Laura) to handle DPA redline turnaround.
3) Ben to confirm pricing window and any volume discount conditions.

Would you like a brief call Monday to walk the packet? I can loop Tom from your counsel if helpful.

Thanks,
Prijom Das
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-close-stitch-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Prijom —

Looks good. A couple of internal notes:
- DPA turnaround: if Novamed returns only *minor* DPA comments we can typically respond in 3 business days. For substantive changes around data residency or logging retention we’ll need more time and potentially a security review (adds ~5–7 business days).
- Please clarify in the workbook that sandbox evals will not include PHI unless we have a signed DPA + scoped data processing addendum.
- Flagging a possible exec approval for an annual commitment >$250k — if their legal signals that order_form_value > $250k, we should prep an internal finance approval path.

Looping Ben for the pricing confirmation so commercial can state a firm order form deliverable date.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Alicia / team —

Pricing windows: we can provide an order form draft with firm pricing within 48 business hours of final scope confirmation. For purposes of your MAP, assume a 7 business day commercial lock window after we receive final seat/throughput info. If Novamed wants an expedited 72-hour sign-off we can do that with a small temporary holdback on volume discounts (we’ll reconcile within 30 days).

If legal needs the order form to reflect interim terms pending MSA completion, I can create a conditional order form that notes execution "subject to" final MSA — but that introduces friction with procurement systems (their PO automation often rejects conditional clauses). Recommend full MSA alignment before final execution to avoid PO re-issuance.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: novamed-dpa-comments-20270715.docx (docx)

---

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
To: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Team —

Thanks — attached is our formal procurement timeline and a short DPA comment set (novamed-dpa-comments-20270715.docx). Our procurement committee meets Wed 21 Jul and our target is to have contracts ready for signature that week.

Key asks from procurement:
- Can Redwood provide a 3–day turnaround commitment for minor DPA redlines?
- Can you confirm whether the sandbox can be provisioned with synthetic data before the DPA is finalized? (we want to start function-level evals this week)
- We will sign the order form the week of 21 Jul, but procurement requires evidence of MSA countersignature policy (i.e., who signs on behalf of Redwood and expected countersign timeline).

I will also send a DocuSign PO link once procurement issues the PO.

Best,
Alicia

Attachment: novamed-procurement-timeline.pdf (pdf)

---

From: Prijom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding — sequencing questions and legal dependencies

Alicia —

Appreciate the timeline and attachments. Quick answers and confirmed next steps:
- DPA turnaround: Laura confirms 3 business days for minor comments; we’ll commit to that for your small edits. If anything touches data residency, we’ll flag immediately with an estimate.
- Sandbox: we can provision a synthetic-data sandbox today; we will not use production keys or PHI until DPA signed. I’ll have infra send credentials to your test lead once we get a brief SOC2 evidence exchange.
- Countersign: Redwood signs at Director-level for standard MSAs; target countersign within 48 business hours after final internal legal approval. We’ll add this language to the workbook.

Proposed target close: 2027-07-30 (end of your procurement week). To hit that we need: final DPA comments back by EOD Tue 2027-07-20 and order form scope locked by Wed 2027-07-21. If procurement can issue the PO into DocuSign that week we’ll prioritize countersign & execution.

Actions I’ll take:
- Update the workbook with the countersign language and sandbox note; upload to the Drive link.
- Laura will standby for DPA redline review.
- Ben: confirm you can produce the order form draft by Tue 2027-07-20 if they provide final scope by EOD Mon.

If that schedule looks good, I’ll set a 30-minute alignment call for Tue 2027-07-20 10:00 AM PT.

Thanks —
Prijom Das
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
